title: netlink-netfilter: Significantly expand dissection for nft
description:
This implements dissection of nftables (NFNL_SUBSYS_NFTABLES) netfilter-netlink packets. In particular, support is added for dissecting rule changes, including support for dissecting and pretty-printing contained expressions. I know very little of either wireshark or nftables, but this patch helped me debug some firewall issues locally so I am hoping it may be useful to others.
